audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Yasuo/Yasuo/Skill/Skill/Yasuo/Yasuo, giving Yasuo levels 2 and 3. The packet chart and every one of this page's own whys[0..4] say Ambessa owns levels 1 through 6.
audit.why: Yasuo has no E target until 3 and no knockup partner for Last Breath early, while Ambessa's Drakehound's Step dash chains off every cast and Lacerate (13s at rank 1) slows him out of the trade. Wind Wall is a dead button — none of her kit is a projectile.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through Level 6 read Ambessa; First item and 2+ items read Yasuo. Rows proposed as a matched full+content group.

audit.why: Spike windows are right: Ambessa at 3-5 and at 6, Yasuo on his first crit item and late. The level-6 phase text was generic, so it now carries Public Execution's 130s rank-1 cooldown and the reason Yasuo cannot answer it yet.
audit.corrected: Windows unchanged; phases[4].why rewritten with the real cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracks a fabricated ability called 'Repeating Dashes' — focus.text, tldr, winCon, enemyWin, ahead, loading, three phase whys, five breakdown keys, dosFull, and six report entries all name it. Ambessa has no such ability.
audit.why: Her real kit is Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). The ability actually worth tracking is Public Execution: a blink that suppresses and stuns, heals her, and is down for 130s at rank 1 — the longest punishable window in her kit. 'Public Execution' is exactly the same character count as the invented name, so every swap keeps its string length.
audit.corrected: Every 'Repeating Dashes' reference replaced with Public Execution, and the tracking line now gives its 130s cooldown instead of the vague 'Her mobility'. Also added the Drakehound's Step auto-reset wind-up as the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Public Execution at 130/115/100 is a two-minute window at rank 1; Repudiation is 18s and grounds, Lacerate is 13s. Those numbers are what make 'fight when it is down' actionable.
audit.corrected: 130s at rank 1 now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[4].why.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Land Public Execution' in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong name. False positive — that is the correct ultimate name.
